_comment: applicationDiagnosticCount is an exact count of measured tsc -p tsconfig.app.json diagnostics (application source only; test/fixture roots are excluded by tsconfig.app.json itself), not a diagnostic-identity snapshot -- fixing one error while introducing another can leave the count unchanged. Update it deliberately in the same change that moves the count. See #2820 for the plan to drive it to zero. applicationNoCheckFileCount is an exact count of application source files carrying @ts-nocheck (R2/#2811 item 5 ported to the app ratchet); it is 0 because none currently exist, and any new @ts-nocheck'd file must be fixed rather than absorbed by raising this count. minimumAppFileCount is a lower bound set to the measured application file count, 864 as of issue 2825; lowering it is only legitimate alongside a deliberate removal or exclusion in the same commit, and the bound is a floor so it goes slack as files are added.
